meta.title: Ti Seguo | One claim. One continuous thread.

brand.ariaLabel: Ti Seguo, back to the top

hero.description: Ti Seguo is an insurance claims management platform that brings insurance companies, agencies, adjusters, repair shops, and customers together in the same operational context. From opening to closure.

scenario.label: Current context
scenario.title: The process fragments as work passes from one stakeholder to the next.
scenario.description: The problem is not the work of each individual party. It is what gets lost between a decision, an update, and the next handoff.

items.description: Updates, documents, and decisions move between different tools and people.
Each stakeholder sees only part of the picture and has to reconstruct what happened.
Limited data transparency during handoffs extends resolution times.

approach.label: Solution
approach.title: One shared context, from opening to closure.
approach.description: Ti Seguo reconnects the journey without changing roles: each stakeholder sees what they need and always knows the next step.

titleParts.text: A shared journey, in real time

items.description: Notifications, shared calendars, integrated chat, and cloud services keep every device updated in real time.
Access to information can be changed dynamically, so each person only sees the information relevant to their responsibilities.
Every stage of a claim has been mapped, making each action predictable.
A network of repair shops communicates with every other stakeholder in real time. Reviews also help customers feel more confident in their choice.
Inspection data is integrated with estimating systems and displayed only to authorized users.
Through a spare-parts supplier, parts can be ordered directly from the inspection report, with tracking and lower operating costs.

difference.title: What makes it different from every other claims management system?
difference.paragraph1: I developed Ti Seguo from the perspective of an insurance agency and the challenges of day-to-day operations. From there, I analyzed what customers were missing to feel truly involved in the journey.
difference.paragraph2: Repair shops and their management became a central part of the analysis because they are the operational heart of resolving a claim.
difference.paragraph3: I then extended the work to the insurance company and its internal processes, observing and evaluating them directly from within.
